pages: All living things are made of one or more cells.
The cell is the basic unit of life.
All cells come from pre-existing cells.
Prokaryotic cells have no nucleus; their DNA lies in the cytoplasm.
Eukaryotic cells have a nucleus bounded by a membrane.
Mitochondria release energy from food by respiration.
The cell membrane controls what enters and leaves the cell.
Plant cells have a cell wall made of cellulose.
A large vacuole holds cell sap and keeps the cell firm.
